en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large formal banquet in an elegant dining room. Long tables covered with white tablecloths, plates and flowers form a U‑shape, and many well‑dressed men and women sit closely together, facing the camera. The room has simple wall paneling, large curtains, and ceiling lamps. Handwritten text appears across the upper part of the image and a small signature or caption at the bottom right.
